topic: Street cricket: Chacha Jee insists on bowling the last ball.

episode.title: Chacha Jee Ki Aakhri Ball!

shots.narration: آخری گیند کراتے ہی چچا کو گھر کا کام کیسے ملا؟
shots.scene: Bright Pakistani residential lane, plain wooden cricket stumps at the far end, warm sunny colours, 3D animated comedy film look, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chacha takes the cricket ball from Pappu's open palm.
shots.mood: Chacha wears a triumphant grin; Pappu raises one doubtful eyebrow.

shots.narration: پپو بولا، چچا، بس سیدھی گیند کرانی ہے!
shots.scene: Same sunny lane, clear view from the bowling spot to plain wooden stumps, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Pappu points directly toward the stumps.
shots.mood: Pappu looks patient and precise; Chacha smiles with absolute confidence.

shots.narration: چچا بولے، میری گیند تو ہوا سے باتیں کرتی ہے!
shots.scene: Bowling end of the narrow Pakistani lane, pastel house walls and sunlit paving, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chacha raises the ball above his head in a grand bowler's pose.
shots.mood: Puffed chest, magnificent moustache, exaggerated sporting confidence.

shots.narration: اتنے میں چاچی دھلے کپڑوں کی ٹوکری لے آئیں۔
shots.scene: House doorway beside the cricket stumps, low doorstep and an empty clothesline overhead, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chachi places a basket of clean white laundry beside the stumps.
shots.mood: Chachi looks composed and busy in the warm afternoon sunshine.

shots.narration: پپو بولا، چچا، سامنے کپڑے ہیں، ذرا سنبھل کر!
shots.scene: Lane viewed from beside the bowling spot, laundry basket clearly visible near the distant stumps, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Pappu holds an open warning palm toward Chacha.
shots.mood: Pappu's eyes widen; Chacha keeps a stubborn, reassuring grin.

shots.narration: چچا بولے، فکر نہ کرو، نشانہ بالکل پکا ہے!
shots.scene: Sunny bowling end of the same lane, plain house walls framing the cricket pitch, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chacha releases the dusty cricket ball with an extravagant bowling swing.
shots.mood: Wildly enthusiastic delivery, flaring waistcoat and fierce concentration.

shots.narration: گیند وکٹ چھوڑ کر سیدھی صاف کپڑوں میں جا گری!
shots.scene: Close view of the laundry basket beside untouched wooden stumps, Chachi standing immediately behind it, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: The dusty ball lands on a clean white garment inside the basket.
shots.mood: A small puff of dust marks the white cloth; Chachi gives a sharp sideways look.

shots.narration: چاچی بولیں، بہت خوب، اب کپڑے بھی آپ دھوئیں!
shots.scene: House doorstep beside the street cricket pitch, laundry basket between Chachi and Chacha, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chachi deposits the laundry basket into Chacha's arms.
shots.mood: Chachi smiles decisively; Chacha's proud grin collapses; Pappu suppresses a gigg

shots.narration: آخری گیند میری، اگلی باری آپ کی؛ کل مشین چلائیے!
shots.scene: Bright household laundry corner just inside the doorway, plain washing machine with blank controls, Chacha holding the laundry basket beside it, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chachi raises the rescued cricket ball like a winner's trophy.
shots.mood: Chachi beams victoriously; Pappu grins; Chacha stares nervously at the washing m

episode.endHook: Agli baar Chacha Jee ka muqabla washing machine se!
episode.description: گلی کے کرکٹ میں چچا جی آخری گیند کرانے پر اڑ گئے۔ پپو کی تنبیہ بھی کام نہ آئی، مگر چاچی جان نے میچ کا نتیجہ ہی بدل دیا!
